snippet.title: Helcast｜Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Helcast, the physics-juggling merge-puzzle roguelite deckbuilder rooted in Norse mythology developed by Ricpau Studios, comes to PC via Steam Early Access in Q1 2027.

Wishlist the game on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3430620/ 

Odin, the All-Father, has declared war on the Underworld. The dishonorable dead have escaped Helheim, and they’re dead-set on Asgard’s destruction. Modgunn, the bridgekeeper between life and death, must fight her way from the realm of the undead to the realm of the gods and put an end to this madness once and for all!

Assemble godslaying builds and battle the unleashed dead in a combat system where merge puzzles and physics add satisfying tactility to each encounter. Drop weapons into shifting platforms to merge them, dealing damage while becoming a bigger, more powerful weapon. Aim and account for mass, velocity, and ricochets to trigger multi-hit merge combo chains. Modgunn strikes whatever stands above the merge — position carefully or a perfect combo might go to waste in an empty corner.


Title: Helcast
Developer: Ricpau Studios
Publisher: HYPER REAL
Platform: PC (Steam)
Genre: Deckbuilding, Roguelite, Puzzle
Release Date: Q1 2027
Supported Languages: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish, German
